_about: The three holders on the bed, as all-shapes-test.js draws them on the machine (hardware-verified). x, y = the holder centre in mm from HOME: the spot where homing ($H) leaves the head, which the agent makes 0,0 after every homing (never the laser's raw machine coordinates, which before the first homing after power-on are off by ~30 mm). width, height = the keychain outline (mm): the border that is engraved; the name and photo go inside it. The printer agent and Laser Queue both read this file; Laser Queue's Test holders > Save here updates a centre. Restart the agent after a change.
